question: Why does a carrier jet reach take-off speed in mere seconds?
answer: A catapult on the carrier deck expands high-pressure steam, which drives a piston and delivers a large force over a very short distance. That force is why the jet reaches take-off speed in seconds, where a runway take-off takes far longer. The page graphs the catapult-launched acceleration against a runway take-off.
move: A huge push over a short deck: take-off speed in seconds.
